name: Para-Wing
description: A powered paraglider wing worn as a backpack. Unfolds into a rigid wing with small electric ducted fans for thrust and climb. It's the most affordable personal air vehicle in GLMZ — less a flying car and more a controlled fall with ambition. Launch from any tall building, ride thermals off heat vents and industrial exhaust, land on any rooftop. The Para-Wing community is tight-knit and secretive, because technically they're violating about forty airspace regulations every time they fly.
propulsion: Rigid fold-out wing, twin electric ducted fans
range: 30 km powered, effectively unlimited in good thermal conditions
tier_availability: Tier 2-3 (affordable but illegal in most airspace)
common_usage: Recreational flying, rooftop-to-rooftop transit, courier work, surveillance avoidance.
story_hooks: Para-Wing pilots discover a layer of air above the city where the thermals form patterns that suggest something massive is generating heat underground
A Para-Wing courier network operates entirely off-grid, visible only to those who know where to look up
